newsitem.title: MEXICO: Wanted Mexican university dean seized at US border.
newsitem.headline: Wanted Mexican university dean seized at US border.

text.p: The former head of a Mexican university was arrested while trying to cross the border into Texas on Wednesday, four months after going into hiding amid charges of embezzlement, police said.
"The arrest was made this morning between 7:30 and 8 a.m. in collaboration with Texas state police," Nuevo Leon state Judicial Police Deputy Director of Operations, Fernando Gonzalez, told reporters.

Manuel Silos, who was caught crossing a bridge between Nuevo Laredo, Mexico, and Laredo, Texas, had been charged with embezzling 13 million pesos ($1.67 million) while chief of the Autonomous University of Nuevo Leon in Monterrey.
Police had published "Wanted" posters offering rewards for information leading to his capture.
Silos was university chief during the administration of Socrates Rizzo, governor of the northern state of Nuevo Leon who resigned last year amid charges of corruption.
The former state attorney general, the official in charge of water and drainage in the state, and the former chief of Judicial Police are also wanted on corruption charges but remain at large.
